per Lemma I: after the equal-width gap is identified with one shrinking rectangle, Lemma I supplies ultimate equality. This is the proof citation, not proximity of statements. Modern monotone-graph rectangle sets now have a derived enclosure and exact finite sum gap, exhausted under shrinking actual maximum widths. Ordinary union-area and ultimate curvilinear ratio identification remain open.

Eædem rationes ultimæ: Lemma III retains Lemma II's inscribed/circumscribed figures and ultimate equal ratios while allowing unequal widths. Its par6 proof replaces the common width by the maximum; it does not name Lemma II. The modern fixed-interval rational graph model constructs the actual maximum width and derives the corresponding rectangle-sum bound; this reference does not certify the historical area-ratio conclusion.
